name: chunk_scaled_dot_kkt
description: Chunked scaled KKT product with signature chunk_scaled_dot_kkt(k, beta, g_cumsum=None, chunk_size=64). k is [B,T,Hg,K], beta is [B,T,H] with H a multiple of Hg, and optional g_cumsum is [B,T,H]. For each chunk and head h, repeat the corresponding key group across H/Hg heads and compute A_ij = (sum_k k_i*k_j) * beta_i; if g_cumsum is given, multiply by exp(g_i-g_j) when g_i-g_j <=0 and by zero otherwise. The stored result is nonzero only for the strict causal region i > j and is zero on and above the diagonal. Return a newly allocated float32 tensor [B,T,H,chunk_size]. Inputs are not modified. The suite exercises bfloat16 k with float32 beta/g_cumsum, chunk sizes 16/32/64, with and without g_cumsum.
